rules.title: No force unwraps at runtime
rules.body: Do not use !, try! or as! on values that can be nil or fail at runtime; use guard let, if let, try with do/catch, or as?.

rules.title: UI work on the main actor
rules.body: Code that updates UI state is marked @MainActor or dispatched to the main actor; shared mutable state is protected by an actor or isolated to one.

rules.title: Weak self in long-lived closures
rules.body: Closures stored by long-lived objects (timers, subscriptions, completion handlers kept by services) capture self weakly; delegates are weak references.

rules.title: Secrets in the Keychain
rules.body: Tokens and credentials are stored in the Keychain, never in UserDefaults, plists or source files.
